services.title: Rent Your Way

services.self.title: Self-drive / Lepas Kunci
services.self.desc: Take the car on your own schedule. Full freedom to follow your own routes, with fuel and pickup terms confirmed on WhatsApp.
services.driver.title: Car Rental with Driver
services.driver.desc: A local, experienced driver at the wheel — so you can enjoy the coastline, terraces, and temples without watching the road.
services.airport.title: Airport Delivery
services.airport.desc: Your car can be waiting when you land in Bali, ready for a smooth start to your trip.
services.hotel.title: Hotel Delivery
services.hotel.desc: Delivered straight to your hotel or villa, wherever you are staying on the island.

why.flex.title: Flexible rental types

why.fleet.title: One fleet, any trip

faq.title: FAQ
faq.1.q: How do I book a car?
faq.1.a: Message us on WhatsApp with your dates, the vehicle you need, and whether you want a driver. We'll reply with availability and a quote.
faq.2.q: Can I take the car without a driver?
faq.2.a: Yes — self-drive (lepas kunci) is one of our rental options. Tell us your plans and we'll confirm the terms on WhatsApp.
faq.3.q: Do you deliver to the airport or my hotel?
faq.3.a: Yes, we offer both airport delivery and hotel delivery. Confirm your pick-up point with us on WhatsApp when booking.
faq.4.q: What type of cars do you have?
faq.4.a: Seven categories: Brio/Agya, Avanza/Xenia, Suzuki XL7, Innova Reborn, Innova Zenix, New Alphard, and Hiace Premio/Luxury.
faq.5.q: How do I get a rental quote?
faq.5.a: Send us a message on WhatsApp with the car type, dates, and pickup location. We'll reply with the price and any terms you need to know.
cta.title: Ready to Hit the Road?
cta.sub: Message us on WhatsApp and we'll get you behind the wheel.
